videos.t: Play is so much more than keeping kids busy!
videos.desc:
We ✨ love ✨ learning through play! Here’s what to expect when you start your youngest with the ChompSaw.👇
Age 3, you’re going to see a lot of demoing cardboard and cutting crazy lines, but that’s a start to building the fine motor skills and spatial awareness needed to start creating shapes.

Around age 5, things start getting three-dimensional. That’s when the problem-solving, inventing, and bringing sketches into the real world really kicks in.

Everyone’s going to go at their own pace, which is kinda the whole point!
